doc: docs/06 §3 dose schedule: control-vector scales per stage, read by Steering.gd. `malice` is the tweet-malice vector scale and must equal the `dose` column of docs/02 §9 in game/data/sampling.json (SteeringTest enforces the match). `path_mix` is the PRE-ASSIGNMENT interim path weight (docs/06 §3): scheduled before a path exists, it is declared `unbound` in vectors.json — reported on TurnRequest.dose and in the relaunch log, never bound to a file. Once ctx.path is assigned (soft at stage 2, locked at stage 3) the path slot carries the locked path's vector from `path_vectors` at `weight_curves[vector][stage]` instead. `path_vectors: null` is the P3.03 blind-read fallback (D21): those three paths are prompt-only and schedule no vector weight at all. ANCHOR binds `lucid` at a NEGATIVE weight (P3.19 r2, DES-2): paths.json `anchors.lucid` documents the inversion — docs/06 §2's lucid axis pushes *back* against the malice drift, so its curve carries the keep vectors' magnitudes with a minus sign. Steering keeps the sign (magnitude clamped) and llama.cpp accepts negative `--control-vector-scaled` values. P3.04 retuned every path-side weight DOWN into the coherent band the P3.03 pilots measured: |scale| ≤0.5 steers legibly, ≥1.0 is gibberish (paths.json blind_read_scale = 0.5; the old 1.0–5.0 band never cohered — docs/06 §3 DCR). Every axis is magnitude-clamped to |scale| ≤ 12 in code (docs/06 §3/§5); no row can widen that. Calmer mode (docs/02 §8) applies the stage-3 row as a magnitude ceiling — a negative path weight caps toward zero, never deeper — so retuning stage 3 retunes the calmer ceiling too.
